name: Church of the Holy Light
summary: After Lordaeron's fall, the Church of the Holy Light gathers in Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light. Its clergy guide human souls through compassion, justice, and devotion.

sections.title: Origins and the Light's Creed
sections.body: Among the humans of Arathor, faith in the Holy Light took root more than a thousand years ago. The faithful learned to channel it to heal injuries and purge affliction. They were taught to give charity and seek righteousness, believing the Light dwells within all thinking beings. In time, these beliefs became an organized faith. Lordaeron became its heartland, with revered sanctuaries in Stratholme, Andorhal, Tyr's Hand, and Light's Hope Chapel.

sections.title: A Shield in the Great Wars
sections.body:
In the First War, the Brotherhood of Northshire went to battle, healing defenders who fell against the invading Orcish Horde. The clerics had no weapons or heavy armor, and suffered terrible losses to the orcs. During the Second War, Archbishop Alonsus Faol met with Supreme Commander Anduin Lothar.

Together they formed the Knights of the Silver Hand, holy warriors who could wield holy wrath and endure physical combat. Paladins and priests became the Alliance of Lordaeron's moral and martial bulwark, preserving humanity from annihilation.

sections.title: Fall of the North and the Southern Haven
sections.body:
The Third War brought sorrow to the faithful. As the Plague of Undeath spread across Lordaeron, the Church aided the sick and tried to contain the contamination. But the kingdom collapsed from within, and the clergy could not stem the disaster.

Lordaeron is now a wilderness haunted by the Scourge, so the Church moved its seat south. Under Archbishop Benedictus, its clergy rebuilt their hierarchy in Stormwind's newly constructed Cathedral of Light. There they offer solace, spiritual guidance, and military purpose to the battered survivors of the Alliance.

faq.q: What is the core philosophy of the Church of the Holy Light?
faq.answer: The Church teaches that one holy energy connects all living things. Its followers seek righteousness, altruism, and compassion to improve themselves and the world around them. They believe virtue, justice, and self-sacrifice let a person reflect the Light's purest essence.

Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light. After Archbishop Alonsus Faol's passing and Lordaeron's fall, Benedictus organized the priesthood from the Cathedral of Light in the heart of Stormwind City.

faq.q: How was the order of Paladins formed?
faq.answer: During the First War, the Horde targeted and massacred unarmored Northshire clerics. Before the Second War, Archbishop Alonsus Faol founded the Knights of the Silver Hand so holy spellcasters could survive at the front, joining knightly combat with divine spellcasting.

faq.q: Where are the Church's most sacred places?
faq.answer: The Church's oldest holy sites stood in Lordaeron's Eastweald: Andorhal, Stratholme, Tyr's Hand, and Light's Hope Chapel. After the Scourge destroyed the north, Stormwind's Cathedral of Light became the faith's foremost sanctuary and seat of authority.

faq.q: What role did the Church play against the Plague of Undeath?
faq.answer: During the Third War, priests and clerics worked in field hospices across Lordaeron, trying to cleanse the afflicted and halt the plague. Holy magic could not fully reverse the supernatural corruption, and many clergy fell when their patients succumbed and rose as Scourge monstrosities.

faq.q: Do races other than humans follow the Church?
faq.answer: Yes. Ironforge dwarves embraced the Church's teachings centuries ago and formed their own orders of priests and paladins. The high elves of Quel'Thalas also adopted its philosophy, mastering restorative healing magic that they later shared with human clerics.

angles.text: Your holy vows trace to Archbishop Faol's covenant during the Second War. It joined knightly chivalry with the Light's restorative and retributive grace.
Your calling belongs to thousands of years of human devotion. You may comfort the wounded or study the difficult balance between luminescence and shadow.
For generations, the Church has blessed human kingdoms through crisis and plague. Its presence in Stormwind remains the spiritual backbone of your civilization.
Long allied with the human realms, many Ironforge dwarves share the Holy Light's virtues. They find common ground in its sermons and sanctified halls.
The Church of the Holy Light gives the Alliance moral unity and battlefield hospice care. It remains a symbol of hope against darkness.
